flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: ocmsadminui utils/models/Icourtmention.d.ts (court mention field type), ocmsadminapi auth/util/JwtUtil.java (user token claims); no AOS, AOS template, date served, registered article or e-signature code in the six repos
note: There is no AOS screen, AOS template, date served field, registered article number or e-signature in the six repos (grep affidavit, aos, oath, commissioner, registered article, date served, designation, e-sign: no relevant hit). Some raw material exists: the Icourtmention type has summon_no and court_no (Icourtmention.d.ts:3-6), and the login token carries username and email (JwtUtil.java:103-104), but there is no designation claim and no code that assembles that data into an AOS. No relevant maintenance ticket. The story status is blank in the data.
recommendation: Do not claim. There is no AOS, template, date served, registered article or e-signature in the repo. Ask the team in which repo this feature was built.
